rules.name: grasa-barrier-inputs-cfs
rules.sql: WITH pairs(client, product) AS (VALUES ('ACM','CM CRD'), ('ACM','CM CT'), ('AMC','CM CT'), ('ASI','CM CT'), ('ASI','CM DF'), ('BFA','CM CT'), ('BOV','CM C'), ('CPB','CM CT'), ('FMP','CM CT'), ('HSD','CM C'), ('IOL','CM BO'), ('IOL','CM RS'), ('LIB','CM CT'), ('MAO','CM W'), ('ORM','CM C'), ('SIP','CM OR EUR')), vd AS (SELECT value_date FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = :bu LIMIT 1), sec AS ( SELECT DISTINCT p.client, p.product, c.security_id FROM opera.helper_sensitivity_report_view_cache_table c JOIN pairs p ON upper(substring(c.contract_number, 1, 3)) = upper(p.client) AND upper(trim(c.product_code)) = upper(trim(p.product)) WHERE upper(trim(c.business_unit)) = :bu), leg AS ( SELECT s.client, s.product, m.security_id, m.derivative_type, m.strike, m.barrier1_level, m.barrier1_rebate, m.maturity_date, m.vol1_id, m.underlying1_id, (SELECT u.settle_value FROM opera.underlying_settle_value_table u WHERE u.underlying_id = m.underlying1_id AND u.value_date = (SELECT value_date FROM vd)) AS settle_px, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM opera.settlement_vol_surf_table sv WHERE sv.vol_id = m.vol1_id AND sv.value_date = (SELECT value_date FROM vd)) AS surface_rows FROM sec s JOIN opera.cloned_security_info_table m ON m.security_id = s.security_id AND upper(m.business_unit) = :bu WHERE m.status = 'Active' AND lower(m.derivative_type) LIKE 'amer%' AND m.maturity_date > (SELECT value_date FROM vd)) SELECT client, product, derivative_type, COUNT(*) AS legs, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE settle_px IS NULL OR settle_px <= 0) AS px_not_positive, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE strike IS NULL OR strike <= 0) AS strike_not_positive, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE barrier1_level IS NULL OR barrier1_level <= 0) AS barrier_not_positive, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE vol1_id IS NULL) AS no_vol1, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE vol1_id IS NOT NULL AND surface_rows = 0) AS no_surface, MIN(security_id) FILTER (WHERE settle_px IS NULL OR settle_px <= 0 OR strike IS NULL OR strike <= 0 OR barrier1_level IS NULL OR barrier1_level <= 0 OR vol1_id IS NULL OR surface_rows = 0) AS sample_bad_security FROM leg GROUP BY client, product, derivative_type ORDER BY client, product, derivative_type
